run_densepose_inference: run end-to-end DensePose inference on a single image or folder of images using a config and weights file
run_infer_simple_cli: run the infer_simple CLI tool with --cfg and --wts flags to process images and output PDF visualizations
parse_args_infer_simple: parse command-line arguments for the DensePose inference tool including config path, weights, output directory, and image extension
main_infer_simple: run the main inference loop that loads a model, processes each image, and saves visualization PDFs to the output directory
review_infer_simple: review the infer_simple module to understand how it performs DensePose inference and visualization on images
